commands.command: PYTHONPATH=src python -m epe.cli --format json graph build
PYTHONPATH=src python -m epe.cli --format json policy validate
PYTHONPATH=src python -m epe.cli --format json architecture validate

change: Current and historical graph loading now validates node and edge minimum shape, provenance, finite confidence in [0,1], and boolean verified fields; query helpers skip malformed direct-call edges rather than raising.
limitations: Shape checks do not authenticate a snapshot against an external immutable store; a writer able to recompute the digest remains trusted.
Historical malformed snapshots return the existing history diagnostic category while current snapshots expose EPE-GRAPH-SHAPE.
